scope: Bounded public-source financing research for 21 published landscape identities. Five source-confirmed events are imported for three companies; secondary-only and aggregate grant claims are retained as explicit source holds rather than converted into facts.

sources.title: EFA Holdings audited accounts disclose acquisition of 42% of Aether Aeronautics for EUR120,000

rounds.note_en: The audited investor accounts describe a purchase of 89,880 shares representing 42%. The consideration is recorded as a secondary investment disclosure; it is not presented as primary proceeds to Aether.
rounds.coverage_note_en: Public financing history was researched through company, investor, registry and transaction-party sources. Unknown private details remain undisclosed; coverage is partial and does not assert a complete cap table.

sources.title: EFA Holdings audited accounts disclose Aether Aeronautics capital increase and EUR600,486 subscription

rounds.note_en: Aether issued 140,629 additional shares subscribed by EFA Holdings for EUR600,486, increasing the investor's holding from 42% to 65%.
rounds.coverage_note_en: Public financing history was researched through company, investor, registry and transaction-party sources. Unknown private details remain undisclosed; coverage is partial and does not assert a complete cap table.

sources.title: BAN Flanders confirms Agilica seed capital from three business angels

rounds.note_en: BAN Flanders confirms that three business angels supplied the seed capital but does not disclose the amount or identify the complete syndicate. BAN Flanders is an intermediary network and is not mislabelled as the direct investor.
rounds.coverage_note_en: Public financing history was researched through company, investor, registry and transaction-party sources. The three angel identities and amount remain undisclosed; coverage is partial and does not assert a complete cap table.
